title: FlowPredictor–Corrector: A Hemodynamics-Guided Two-Step Deep Learning Framework for Vascular Flow Prediction
authors_text: Zhuo Li, Yao Zeng, Mengfei Wang, Yulu Yang, Meixiu Pan, Ao Liu, Qiang Sun, Haifeng Zhao, Ruipeng Zhang, Yuehua Li
venue: IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics
abstract: FlowPredictor–Corrector (FPC) is a hemodynamics-guided, two-step deep learning framework that combines 3D vascular point-cloud representation learning with physics-based hemodynamic correction to non-invasively map 3D vascular geometry to 4D blood-flow fields, balancing rapid inference with physical consistency across reference CFD simulations and clinical vascular evaluations.
authorship_source: Author manuscript (R2), title-page corresponding-author footnote; published author list: https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/11726865/authors
